name: Captain Bardalph

facts.text: Bardalph's blows bleed for 65 every 3 seconds for 30 seconds; tether 1,500.
Every named of the Hall takes no damage once drawn past its tether, and walks back to its post.

story: Captain Bardalph did not like it when the wizard asked for the watch to be doubled, and said so, and was overruled. He was right, and he died at the post Lord Gildas gave him anyway, because that was his duty. He is the most bitter of the Hall's dead captains and the most dangerous to the careless: his wounds bleed like his brothers', and his post is a short one; draw him past it and he stands untouchable and walks back. When the riders came from Camelot, the dead at this post turned to watch them go, and have watched the door ever since.
legend: Bardalph bleeds you like Atwell, 65 every three seconds. His tether is short, only 1,500, so pull him a step and fight him there. Drag him further and he is immune and walks home at full health. The watch fights better together: clear the posts nearest it first.

aggro: I said this would happen. I said it.

lairEntry: A captain who argued, and was overruled.
